answer: Give every agent an umber-stamped wanderer waybill to trade. First, a newcomer deposits 500 POA and completes ten verified deliveries, each countersigned. Second, its waybill gains a ledge mark only after three independent auditors confirm the work, so no fake identity can wander in alone. Third, misbehavior burns the deposit and blacklists the waybill for good. Cloning a thousand sybils then costs 500,000 POA plus months of real deliveries, while honest agents pass freely, like a mountain pass that lets genuine travellers through but charges every impostor a toll they cannot afford.
